normalization_method: rolling mean and population std (ddof=0) over the PREVIOUS 200 bars (window [i-LOOKBACK, i), shifted by 1 so the current bar is excluded); z = (basis - mean) / std; NaN -> 0.0
weighting_method: TB-B exact-neutral: min ||q - q_alpha||^2 s.t. E q = 0, sum q = 1, q >= 0, where E is the USD-normalized currency-exposure matrix from verify_tb_04a.exposure_matrix; sizes s = 3*q; q_alpha = canonical inverse-ATR normalized shares (1/ATR per leg, scaled to sum |s| = 3)
control_weighting_note: TB-B weights are computed at entry time from entry prices + frozen conversion rates; they are model weights, NEVER interpreted as MT5 lots
primary_entry_rule_exact: |z| > 3.0 (strictly greater; the forward-spec text '>= 3.0' is a measure-zero paraphrase - the canonical code uses >)
primary_exit_rule_exact: same rolling z-score as entry (NOT a re-normalized trade-relative z): SHORT trade exits when z <= -0.25 (overshoot below zero); LONG trade exits when z >= +0.25 (symmetric by |z| geometry)
control_exit_rule_exact: SHORT exits when z <= 0.0; LONG exits when z >= 0.0
stop_rule_exact: SHORT exits when z >= +6.0; LONG exits when z <= -6.0

session.name: London Only
session.timezone: fixed UTC-5 offset via (hour - 5) % 24, no DST adjustment

direction_convention: z > 0 (basis rich) -> SHORT basket (short GBPAUD, long GBPNZD, short AUDNZD); z < 0 (basis cheap) -> LONG basket (long GBPAUD, short GBPNZD, long AUDNZD)
reentry_semantics: max 1 concurrent basket; after a close, a new in-session |z| > threshold re-enters (no cooldown); a trade that converges to z=0 and then re-dislocates may produce a subsequent trade in the same session
